name: net_session_browser_dialog_destructor
description: NetSessionBrowserDialog::Destructor tears down the multiplayer session-browser MFC dialog shell in reverse construction order. Direct production host: mission.cpp.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
Binary Ninja still shows MSVC EH registration scaffolding around the destructor sequence, but the teardown body and provider calls are verified.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x41aeb0 validates reverse construction-order teardown: CString at 0x1b0, CComboBox at 0x170, CListBox at 0x130, CButton at 0xf0, CButton at 0xb0, CEdit at 0x70, and CDialog base at 0x0.
The native smoke constructs the dialog through the recovered constructor, mutates the player-name CString, and runs the recovered destructor through the MFC provider-backed control objects.
